project: LRTT — per-cell TPE sweeps over (af_ratio × update_noise_ratio)
search_space: Per cell: 30 TPE trials over (transfer_lr, fast_lr, classifier_lr) — log-uniform, see search_space in each cell json.
headline_findings: tikitaka_v1 dominates: 5x5 grid mean is highest of the three methods; degradation under af_ratio is small (97.97→95.28).
lrtt_v1 is competitive at low (af, unr) but degrades faster with af_ratio (97.77→93.74 along unr=0 column).
lrtt_v2 is more robust across the grid (flatter) but caps lower (~97.0–97.2), reflecting the v2 SRA design tradeoff.
Best HP regions are noticeably different between methods — TPE warm-start is not transferable across method.
